title: The Brave Little Rabbit
story: Once upon a time there lived a brave little rabbit who helped every animal in the forest. Everyone loved him because kindness is the greatest strength.

title: The Helpful Elephant
story: A gentle elephant lived in a beautiful jungle. He always helped smaller animals and showed everyone that kindness makes the world better.

title: The Magic Forest
story: A young child entered a magical forest and discovered that courage, friendship, and honesty can overcome every challenge.
